proves.claim: counterProofStats on a board with 200,000 per-event proof counters returns the same totals as a whole read, with and without since, while no read returns more than 5,000 counter rows

verify.io-proof-derived-reads.proof-stat.why: On a 770k-event board one read of every per-event counter held about 200 MB of text in the API worker; without this case the whole-table read could come back unnoticed.
